scenarios.scenario: Student guesses the attachment id of a library file not linked to their lessons
scenarios.rationale: canAccessAttachment grants a student only when the item is linked to a lesson with studentId = actor and status <> 'cancelled'; otherwise it falls through to the plan block, which returns false for a non-plan file. Smoke: unrelated student 403; e2e: disposable student 403.

scenarios.scenario: Student of a cancelled lesson keeps downloading the material
scenarios.rationale: The student/teacher join requires lessons.status <> 'cancelled' and is evaluated per request; bootstrap drops the link too. Smoke: 200 before cancel, 403 after.

scenarios.scenario: Manager turns a request-evidence file or another user's upload into a library item to widen its audience
scenarios.rationale: POST /library requires uploadedBy = actor unless admin (403) and rejects any attachment referenced by requests.attachmentId (422 ATTACHMENT_NOT_ELIGIBLE), even for admin. Smoke covers both.

scenarios.scenario: Teacher attaches a file by calling the route directly
scenarios.rationale: All four library routes use requireRole(['admin','manager']); teacher and student get 403 before the handler. Smoke: teacher/student attach and detach 403.

scenarios.scenario: PATCH mass-assignment of attachmentId or createdBy
scenarios.rationale: The PATCH schema is .strict() and has no attachmentId/createdBy keys; any unknown key is a 400. Smoke asserts all three plus an empty body.

scenarios.scenario: Archived item re-exposed to managers outside its team
scenarios.rationale: The manager shortcut only applies to status 'published'; archived items need a link to a team teacher's lesson (or creator). Smoke: other manager 403 on an archived item, bootstrap omits it.

scenarios.scenario: Library block shadows or bypasses the plan block
scenarios.rationale: The block only returns true and never returns false, so a file that is both a library item and a plan file still reaches the unchanged plan logic. The admin/uploader early return, request-evidence block, and plan block are byte-for-byte unchanged (diff shows only the import line and the inserted block).

scenarios.scenario: Teacher/student bootstrap leaks another student's links or manager user rows
scenarios.rationale: Links are filtered to visibleLessons (own lessons) minus cancelled; createdBy/attachedBy are added to referencedUserIds only for managers. Smoke checks every non-admin role's link rows against its lesson set and that a fresh creator (managerC) is absent.

scenarios.scenario: Request evidence becomes student-visible because a library item exists
scenarios.rationale: Evidence cannot back a library item (422), and the request block still runs first and never grants students. Smoke: evidence download 403 for the student with library items present.

scenarios.scenario: A request cites a library attachment id to reach it through the request-evidence audience
scenarios.rationale: Pre-existing: POST /requests stores any client attachmentId without ownership checks. A teacher could cite a library file id; this grants only the existing request-evidence audience (that teacher and their manager), who can usually see published library items anyway. Not introduced by this phase; tracked as backlog request-attachment-ownership_NOTE_24-11-26.md.

scenarios.scenario: Race between archiving an item and attaching it
scenarios.rationale: Not asserted (documented in 'What This Coverage Does NOT Prove'). Worst case an item archived concurrently gets one extra link, which only grants the linked lesson's teacher/student access; archive never revokes existing links by design.

scenarios.scenario: Step F: Client-supplied storageKey traversal via plan attach (e.g. '../.env')
scenarios.rationale: Plan attach is strict { attachmentId }; extra keys are 400 and the route never inserts attachments rows (smoke F5 c/f).

scenarios.scenario: Step F: Absolute, Windows-drive, UNC or alternate-data-stream storage keys
scenarios.rationale: resolveUploadPath rejects ':' and NUL and any key whose relative path is absolute or climbs out; asserted under path.win32 on every OS.

scenarios.scenario: Step F: Sibling directory sharing the upload dir name prefix ('../up-evil/x')
scenarios.rationale: Segment-based relative check, not string prefix; unit case.

scenarios.scenario: Step F: Empty or '.' key reading the upload directory itself
scenarios.rationale: rel === '' returns null -> 404.

scenarios.scenario: Step F: Mass assignment of id/uploadedBy/name on plan attach
scenarios.rationale: Strict schema; metadata comes only from the stored upload row.

scenarios.scenario: Step F: Manager attaches another manager's upload or request evidence to a plan
scenarios.rationale: Uploader-or-admin rule (403) and request-evidence rule (422), same as POST /library; smoke a/d.

scenarios.scenario: Step F: Other managers' user rows leaking through the library in a manager bootstrap
scenarios.rationale: Manager-only referencedUserIds block removed; creator shown via createdByName only; smoke iv.

scenarios.scenario: Step F: Attach racing detach returning 500
scenarios.rationale: Retry once then 409 CONFLICT; smoke 5 rounds never 500.

scenarios.scenario: Step F: Bogus status persisted and silently coerced
scenarios.rationale: DB CHECK (23514) plus strict libraryStatus mapper that throws.

scenarios.scenario: Step F: Pre-existing hostile storage_key rows in dev data
scenarios.rationale: Read-time containment makes them harmless to download. Residual: historical rows are not audited and admin school-import storageKey stays client-supplied (backlog).
